bias.en: Bearish · slipped under $680, testing the July lows
bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 $680，测试 7 月低点

read.en: Lumentum slipped 0.6% on Nov 3 to $680.16, trading between $667.40 and $719.97. It is below the falling 5-day ($807.8), 10-day ($808.2), 30-day ($920.2) and 100-day ($864.7) and the rising 200-day ($804.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($972.41), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月3日下跌 0.6%，收于 $680.16，盘中区间 $667.40–719.97。股价位于下行的 5 日（$807.8）、10 日（$808.2）、30 日（$920.2）和 100 日均线（$864.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$804.7）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$972.41），RSI 为 34。

read.en: A bounce to $720 faded, and the close slipped under the $679–683 support (Nov 2 low, Jul 7–8 lows), now resistance; the low was $667.4. Resistance is $679–683, then $720 (Nov 3 high) and $736.0–746.2 (October lows). Support is $667.4, then $650–651 (July lows) and $594.8–602.3. A close back above $683 would target $720–741; below $650, $595–602.

r.en: Nov 2 low $679; Jul 7 and Jul 8 lows ($680.4–683.4), lost
